item.title: Windows Wrap: Microsoft starts fixing Windows 11 as its OpenAI 'marriage' hits the rocks
item.description: Microsoft restored the movable Taskbar to Windows 11 as the OpenAI partnership showed new cracks. Plus, the latest Presidents' Day PC deals.

item.title: I build gaming PCs for a living, and these pre-builds with Presidents' Day discounts are a smarter buy — but they won't last long
item.description: Some of my favorite desktop gaming PC components are readily available in iBUYPOWER's pre-built desktops, discounted for a limited time during Presidents' Day.

item.title: Indie smash hit Mewgenics is working its way to consoles — the roguelike's co-creator confirms they're "working on it now"
item.description: Mewgenics, the new indie roguelike from Edmund McMillen, is set to receive a console release. The creator confirmed development is underway, following over 900,000 estimated Steam sales and strong early momentum. Paid DLC is also planned.

item.title: I found 7 of Best Buy's greatest Presidents' Day laptops discounted up to 50% — never worry about missing work deadlines again
item.description: We have gathered up the Best Buy's greatest discounts on productivity laptops to help fellow Americans blaze through workloads in honor of Presidents' Day.

item.title: Acer and ASUS face a sales ban in Germany over a video codec issue with Nokia — Here's how this patent spat could affect you
item.description: Acer and Asus have temporarily stopped selling certain PCs in Germany after a court granted Nokia an injunction over alleged HEVC patent infringement. Retailers can sell existing stock, but new imports are blocked while the dispute continues.

item.title: World of Warcraft leads pledge more player customization — housing, race updates, custom animations, and glyphs to merge with transmog?
item.description: We spoke to Maria Hamilton, Design Director and Jay Hwang, Principal Artist on World of Warcraft's bigger emphasis on player housing, customization, and what we could see next from the game.

item.title: This Lenovo laptop is so good I bought one for my son, and at this President's Day price, it's easily the budget buy I recommend
item.description: Lenovo's IdeaPad Slim 3X is heavily discounted for President's Day and if you're shopping on a budget, this is definitely the laptop deal you should grab.

item.title: Presidents' Day has good news for World of Warcraft players — one of our favorite gaming keyboards and a fabulous MMO mouse are on a 35% sale
item.description: Presidents' Day has given Best Buy a chance to sell off a couple of vital discounted PC gaming accessories for players looking to conquer World of Warcraft's upcoming Midnight expansion.

item.title: Activision confirms spring shutdown date for Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile servers
item.description: Just two years after launching, Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile is set to go offline on April 17, 2026. The game was previously delisted from app stores in 2025, and there will be no refunds on unused COD points prior to shutdown.

item.title: Xbox teaser suggests Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 could come to Game Pass soon
item.description: Warhorse Studios' epic medieval journey, Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, could follow in the path of its predecessor and join the lineup of games in the Xbox Game Pass subscription service, according to a new social media teaser.
